subject: writing parameters to vectors in model

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: writing parameters to vectors in model
parts:
I included the following pair of signatures in the generated
model code, but would be happy to reconfigure if others
have suggestions. If these are OK, I can do the same thing
with names.

void write_array_params(std::vector<double>& params_r__,
std::vector<int>& params_i__,
std::vector<double>& vars__,
std::ostream* pstream__ = 0);

The above would call the following with a dummy RNG
and the include_tparams__ and include_gqs__ set to false.

template <typename RNG>
void write_array(RNG& base_rng__,
std::vector<double>& params_r__,
std::vector<int>& params_i__,
std::vector<double>& vars__,
bool include_tparams__ = false,
bool include_gqs__ = false,
std::ostream* pstream__ = 0);

This second one's a bit tricky because including the
generated quantities (gqs) requires including the
transformed parameters (tparams). I could make this an
enum or something, with values PARAMS_ONLY, PARAMS_TPARAMS_ONLY,
PARAMS_TPARAMS_GQS.

Also, the int parameters are currently ignored --- we don't even allow
them yet. I have a feeling a lot of the code involving int
params, which is just stubbed for now, will have to change.

- Bob
